alerts.name: heartbeat-missing
alerts.query: Feature = 'feature126' and EventType = 'Heartbeat' and HeartbeatAgeMs > HeartbeatTimeoutMs

alerts.name: run-stuck
alerts.query: Feature = 'feature126' and LifecycleState in ['Running','Handoff'] and RunAgeMs > RunDeadlineMs

alerts.name: partial-success
alerts.query: Feature = 'feature126' and Outcome = 'partial_success' and FailedCompanies > PartialFailureTolerance

dashboard.name: Feature 126 production
dashboard.eventTimelineQuery: Feature = 'feature126' and RunId = @runId | order by EventSequence
dashboard.latestRunsQuery: Feature = 'feature126' and is not null(RunId) | group by RunId | latest(1)
